algorithm.decoder_accumulation: FP32 multiplication of the two stored FP16 factors
algorithm.final_assignment: minimum absolute scale error against frozen FP16-anchor times FP16-ratio products
algorithm.fit: deterministic Lloyd iterations in log-ratio space
algorithm.ratio_codebook: one 16-entry FP16 multiplicative codebook per tensor with entry zero fixed to exact zero
algorithm.row_anchor: geometric mean of nonzero group scales in each output row, frozen to FP16
